normal.name: Rin, Halloween Edition
normal.text: It’s funny that I frame my identity as a person who plays games, but doesn’t have nostalgia for “old games were harder experiences” But then I watch Super Mario Sunshine, the game I consider the 3D Mario I am nostalgic for, and I go “oh no… this game gave me joy”

heated.name: Matthew Brice
heated.text: Morally and ethically I say impeach. Politically I say it is neutral at best, and for many voters it's a loser. Voters see it as same old games when they are hurting in the pocketbook. Can do both of course. But need to emphasize tackling the economic issues.
